name: Louis-François, Baron Lejeune

summary.text: Brigade-General Louis-François, Baron Lejeune was a French Army officer, painter, lithographer and politician who served in the French Revolutionary and Napoleonic Wars. His memoirs have frequently been republished and his name is engraved on the Arc de Triomphe.
summary.title: Louis-François Lejeune
